title: Mediterranean Blue Carolina Retractable Wall Hook (Patent Pending) - 2-1/2" Pull-Out, Wall Mount Brass, Allied Brass
body_html:
Keep towels, robes, and clothing within reach—then tuck them away when you’re done in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Backed by a lifetime warranty, this Carolina retractable wall hook provides 2-1/2" of pull-out hanging space and pushes back in to save space.

  • Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Personalize the look by swapping the removable knob tip with your own cabinet knob
  • Holds up to 15 lb for confident everyday use
  • Brass construction for an enduring upgrade over common die-cast zinc alternatives

Complete the look: Part of the Carolina collection—coordinate with matching Carolina classic bath accessories and traditional bathroom hardware.

Specs
- Product type: Retractable wall hook (patent pending)
- Hanging space: 2-1/2" pull-out
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 1.75" x 1.75" x 3.75"
- Projection: 1"
- Material: Brass
- Mounting: Wall mount; fits standard interior walls
- Installation: Drill 3/4" diameter hole through drywall plus three small holes around; includes toggle bolts (6/32 toggles) and mounting hardware
- Weight capacity: 15 lb
- Warranty: Lifetime warranty
meta_description: Carolina retractable wall hook (patent pending) with 2-1/2" pull-out hanging space, wall-mount brass construction, and 15 lb capacity—Allied Brass.
